topic.source_contract: Heat-network zoning, project development, Ofgem authorisation, registration and consumer-protection evidence

facts.zoning: areas expected to offer low-cost low-carbon heat-network opportunity
facts.status: zoning implementation statutory instrument was still being developed in March 2026
facts.guard: pipeline opportunity is not designated zone or connection commitment

facts.regulation: operating heat networks have deemed authorisation and applicable authorisation conditions
facts.guard: regulatory authorisation is not planning consent or network capacity

facts.registration: scope, operator/supplier roles and required information
facts.guard: registration does not prove technical or commercial connection
consumer compliance is separate from development delivery

facts.market_framework: Ofgem regulatory framework introduced in January 2026
facts.guard: regulatory transition and zoning implementation are separate

scope_guards: A potential or pipeline heat-network zone is not treated as a designated statutory zone.
HNDU support is not treated as planning approval or funded construction.
Ofgem authorisation is not treated as network capacity or a site connection.
Registration is not treated as consumer compliance in all respects.
Consumer-protection compliance and planning/land rights are kept separate.
Heat demand, plant capacity and pipe capacity are not conflated.
A connection offer is not treated as constructed and commissioned supply.
No score or promotion is written without exact zone status, route, capacity, offer, rights, consent, regulation and delivery.
